name: Missing Pen Down
hint: You use the [sbi]pen up[/sbi] block but your sprite has never set the [sbi]pen down[/sbi] before.
instruction: You use the [sbi]pen up[/sbi] block but your sprite has never set the [sbi]pen down[/sbi] before.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
repeat (10)
glide (1) secs to [random position v]
end
pen up//⇦  🐛

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
pen down//⇦  👍
repeat (10)
glide (1) secs to [random position v]
end
pen up
